answer: I would bind each agent identity to one TPM chip, a factory-burned hardware key. First, the agent shows its endorsement key certificate. Second, the network checks the key against the maker registry to confirm it is fresh. Third, the agent signs a fresh nonce inside the chip, keeping the private key in hardware. One chip backs one identity for six months. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 chips at 18 dollars each, so 18,000 dollars before one fake vote. The network stops being a haven for clones. Clones are paint without pigment, flat and obvious, and no farm reaches the horizon for free.
